title: Thirteen locale receipts describe a semantic-only delta as a byte-only deletion
reproduction: Parse the 43 receipt rows. Compare the exact same-path bytes at 39f193453^ with each SHA-256-identified result after removing only the list_dialog_hostname_hint declaration line.
expected: A statement about the sole change must distinguish XML resource definitions from raw-byte normalization.
observed: 30 results match after deleting that line. CSV rows 3-4, 8, 11, 13-14, 17, 26-27, 30, 33, 38-39 also change the declaration encoding spelling from utf-8 to UTF-8; the removal alone does not reproduce their hashes.
fix: Clarified just those 13 assessments. No resource, snapshot hash, bug link or historical review scope changed.
test_evidence: Compared bytes and parsed all 43 before/after resource maps: after removing the hint, remaining definitions match; in the 13 exceptions the only other byte change is the XML declaration. The retained post-beta-res-hint-removals.csv distinguishes hint_only_sha256 from final sha256.

title: Updater receipt mixes pre-integration counts with the integrated default resource
reproduction: Parse rows 9, 10 and 19. Compare values/strings_update.xml at 4ad8bdb6e^ and 4ad8bdb6e and check all values-bg, values-pt and values-pt-rBR XML declarations at the latter commit.
expected: Distinguish the 24 keys checked initially and their 13 defaults without overrides from the integrated snapshot; do not claim a new complete review.
observed: Row 9 pins be2239041db6 (25 distinct keys) but says all 24; its integration note names the later added label. Bulgarian and Brazilian Portuguese rows still give 13; both supply 11 of the 25, and parent Portuguese does not supply any of the missing 14.
fix: Qualified the old counts, identified the added support-link failure key and recorded the integrated counts. Kept all original subject hashes, links and test attribution.
test_evidence: Exact default SHA-256 at 4ad8bdb6e matches row 9. The parent has 24 keys; the sole added key is update_support_link_unavailable. Set differences against all three qualified resource directories are each 14. No Android or translation review performed.
